queries.sql: SELECT `teams`.`id`, `teams`.`tournament_id`, `teams`.`pot_id`, `teams`.`name`, `teams`.`sort_order`, `pots`.`name` AS `pot_name`, COALESCE(pots.tournament_id, teams.tournament_id) AS tournament_id, COALESCE(pot_tournaments.name, team_tournaments.name) AS tournament_name FROM `teams` LEFT JOIN `pots` ON `pots`.`id` = `teams`.`pot_id` LEFT JOIN `tournaments` AS `pot_tournaments` ON `pot_tournaments`.`id` = `pots`.`tournament_id` LEFT JOIN `tournaments` AS `team_tournaments` ON `team_tournaments`.`id` = `teams`.`tournament_id` WHERE ( `pots`.`tournament_id` = 2 OR ( teams.pot_id IS NULL AND `teams`.`tournament_id` = 2 ) ) ORDER BY `teams`.`name` ASC, `teams`.`sort_order` ASC
